surface_strategies.storefront_cards: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for store elements. Apply glassmorphism: bg-[#1a1d27]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl hover:border-[#F5A623]/50 transition-all duration-300
surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Use Shadcn Card component. Override to solid background: bg-[#1a1d27] border border-white/5 rounded-xl
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: bg-[#F5A623] text-[#0f1117] hover:bg-[#d98f1a] font-semibold. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5

implementation_instructions: NOTE: The frontend environment uses JavaScript (.js, .jsx), NOT TypeScript. Do not create or expect .tsx files.
Configure Tailwind with the custom colors: background (#0f1117), surface (#1a1d27), and primary (#F5A623).
Apply 'dark' class to the html/body element to enforce dark mode across Shadcn components.

Storefront: Hero section must have the store name 'CreativeStore' and tagline. Show the product catalog grid with photo, name, original price (strikethrough), discounted price, short description, and 'Pesan Sekarang' button.

Order Modal: Include fields for Name, WA/Telegram, and Payment Method (QRIS/Transfer Bank). If a '?ref=' parameter is in the URL, track it invisibly in the form state. On submit, show an Order ID like 'ORDXXXX'.
Partnership Page: Side-by-side cards. Affiliate card has a registration form. Reseller card has a 'Hubungi WhatsApp' button.

Affiliate Dashboard: Authenticate by Affiliate ID. Display Name, ID, Referral Link (with copy to clipboard), Saldo Komisi, Total Withdrawn, Sales History table, Withdraw History table, and Withdraw form.
Admin Panel: Password protected. Tabs for Products (CRUD, discount toggle, commission %, stock), Orders (confirm/cancel), Affiliates, Withdrawals (approve/reject).
All copy MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia.
CRITICAL TESTING REQUIREMENT: Every interactive element (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) MUST have a kebab-case 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="order-submit-button"').
